The whole harness, at a glance.

One portable catalog projected into three runtimes. Entry routers own whole pipelines; stages are the sealed workers they dispatch. Filter by profile to see exactly what an installation exposes.

26capabilities
12entry routers
28role units
3runtimes

Research first

Ground new intent in evidence before building.
autopilot-researchentry

Shared upfront research that surveys academic, technology, or market sources before downstream routing.

analyze-projectentry

Creates persistent analysis of existing code, papers, or documents; initial analysis defaults here unless read-only/no-file or another primary applies.

Code & experiments

Spec-governed implementation and rapid experiment loops.
autopilot-specentry

Create or update requirements/blueprints while keeping `prd.md` as the only spec-change path.

autopilot-codeentry

Code-work entrypoint that detects spec context and closes the plan→execute→test→report loop.

autopilot-labentry

Rapid experiment prototyping around training setup and checkpoint evaluation/analysis.

autopilot-shipentry

Prepare application deployment/release setup and a ship checklist.

code-planstage

Analyze code, write a detailed implementation plan, and run the plan-check gate at the rigor derived from intensity.

code-executestage

Execute a plan step by step, delegate implementation to the development role, and record an execution log.

code-refinestage

Revise an existing plan using user notes, plan-check feedback, and verification-failure notes.

code-teststage

Verify implementation results in stages and record evidence.

code-reportstage

Assemble code-cycle results into a user-facing report.

Documents

Papers, reports, proposals — drafted, refined, applied.
autopilot-draftentry

Document-drafting pipeline that produces an applicable artifact through strategy, drafting, verification, and editing.

autopilot-refineentry

Correct and update existing document/research artifacts while preserving snapshots and change history.

autopilot-applyentry

Apply a cheatsheet draft to the real source artifact and verify the result.

draft-strategystage

Create an initial document strategy and evidence-based writing plan.

draft-refinestage

Refine a draft by applying memo/review feedback to a document strategy or draft.

Design

Reference-grounded visual design with token contracts.
autopilot-designentry

Visual-design pipeline coordinating references→tokens→components→review→handoff.

design-initstage

Bootstrap the design environment and state.

design-refsstage

Collect external and user-provided visual references and create a brief.

design-tokensstage

Define design tokens such as color, typography, and spacing.

design-componentsstage

Build UI components/mockups and preview artifacts.

design-reviewstage

Review design output for quality, token-contract compliance, and breakage.

design-handoffstage

Package design results as assets and specifications for development handoff.

Cross-project & operations

Continuity, inspection, and the user profile.
analyze-userentry

Create or update a cross-project user-preference profile from coding, writing, and analysis patterns.

auditentry

Read-oriented post-run inspection for artifact drift, inconsistency, and omissions.

post-itstage

Store project/cross-project notes and handoffs in working memory.
